description: Expected results for the official DualSPHysics 2D dam-break validation case CaseDambreakVal2D (examples/main/01_DamBreak, DualSPHysics v5.4 git ef3721a): water column 1 m wide x 2 m high collapses in a 4 m tank, dp=0.01 m, 21,001 particles, TimeMax 2.0 s, CPU, 8 OpenMP threads. inputs/ are the unmodified files from the official git; nothing in the case was changed. Values recorded from real runs on this server. Runs are deterministic: run1 (8 threads), the run_reference.py runs (8 threads) and an older local run of the same binary with 64 threads gave byte-identical gauge CSVs and final particle file.
engine_version: DualSPHysics5 v5.4.355 (08-04-2025) CPU, GenCase v5.4.354.01, MeasureTool v5.4.266.01

reference: Official experimental reference shipped with the case: 'EXP_X-DamTipPosition_Koshizula&Oka1996.txt' (front position vs time; Koshizuka & Oka 1996, Nucl. Sci. Eng. 123:421-434). The simulated front runs ahead of the experiment by about 0.26 m on average (bias), as is common for SPH dam-break fronts vs this experiment. The last 2 experiment points (x>=3.9 m, one beyond the 4 m tank) are left out of the error checks because the simulated front stops at the wall.

sha256_informational.note: byte-identical between runs on this server (8 and 64 threads)
